lines.en: We missed the train by two minutes! If we had left the apartment sooner, we would have caught it.
lines.pt: Perdemos o trem por dois minutos! Se tivéssemos saído do apartamento antes, teríamos pegado.

lines.en: I know. If I hadn’t stopped for coffee, we would have arrived on time.
lines.pt: Eu sei. Se eu não tivesse parado para tomar café, teríamos chegado a tempo.

lines.en: And if the line hadn’t been so long, you wouldn’t have wasted ten minutes in that shop.
lines.pt: E se a fila não tivesse sido tão longa, você não teria perdido dez minutos naquela loja.

lines.en: If I had checked the timetable last night, I would have realized that the first train was full.
lines.pt: Se eu tivesse conferido o horário ontem à noite, teria percebido que o primeiro trem estava lotado.

lines.en: If you had told me, I would have called a taxi. It would have been much faster.
lines.pt: Se você tivesse me contado, eu teria chamado um táxi. Teria sido bem mais rápido.

lines.en: True. Would we have caught the train if we had taken a taxi from your street?
lines.pt: É verdade. Será que teríamos pegado o trem se tivéssemos pegado um táxi na sua rua?

lines.en: Probably. If the traffic had been normal, we would have reached the platform in fifteen minutes.
lines.pt: Provavelmente. Se o trânsito estivesse normal, teríamos chegado à plataforma em quinze minutos.

lines.en: Now the next train leaves in two hours. If we hadn’t missed it, we would already be at the lake.
lines.pt: Agora o próximo trem sai em duas horas. Se não o tivéssemos perdido, já estaríamos no lago.

lines.en: Let’s not blame ourselves. If we hadn’t missed it, we wouldn’t have found this little bakery.
lines.pt: Vamos não nos culpar. Se não o tivéssemos perdido, não teríamos encontrado esta padariazinha.

lines.en: You are right. If we had caught the train, we would never have tried these delicious cinnamon rolls.
lines.pt: Você tem razão. Se tivéssemos pegado o trem, nunca teríamos provado estes deliciosos rolinhos de canela.

lines.en: Exactly. Let’s order two coffees, and this time please look at the schedule for the return trip.
lines.pt: Exatamente. Vamos pedir dois cafés e, desta vez, por favor, veja o horário da volta.

facts.big: If we had left sooner, we would have caught it
facts.label: 3º condicional
facts.sub: Se + had + particípio, would have + particípio: If I had known, I would have called. Fala do passado que não aconteceu.

facts.label: se + tivesse + particípio
facts.sub: No 3º condicional, a parte do if usa past perfect: If we had left sooner. Fala de uma situação do passado que não aconteceu. Não use would have depois de if.

facts.label: teria + particípio
facts.sub: A outra parte usa would have + particípio: we would have caught it. Mostra o resultado que não aconteceu: If I had called, she would have come.

compare.ask: If I had known, I would have called.
compare.br: Em português, dizemos “se tivéssemos saído antes, teríamos pegado”.
compare.tip: Diga: “If I had known, I would have called.”
compare.us: Em inglês, o 3º condicional usa if + past perfect (had + particípio), e na outra parte would have + particípio: If we had left sooner, we would have caught it. Não use would have depois de if.

items.s: If we had left sooner, we would have caught it is about the past.
items.why: Yes, it is about an unreal past situation.

items.s: The third conditional uses if + simple past.
We say “If I had known, I would have called.”

answers: If we had left sooner, we would have caught it is about the past. → Verdadeiro (Yes, it is about an unreal past situation.)
The third conditional uses if + simple past. → Falso (It uses if + past perfect.)
We say “If I had known, I would have called.” → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: A missed train in Seattle · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a gray Saturday morning in Seattle. Sara and Pam run into the station with their bags. The doors of the train close right in front of them. The train slowly leaves the platform. The two friends look at each other and laugh nervously. They begin to talk about what went wrong.

“We missed the train by two minutes! If we had left the apartment sooner, we would have caught it.” says Pam. “I know. If I hadn’t stopped for coffee, we would have arrived on time.” says Sara. “And if the line hadn’t been so long, you wouldn’t have wasted ten minutes in that shop.” says Pam.
